description: BidiIsolation.ALWAYS with a template naming the SAME placeholder twice. StringInterpolator looks the value up per occurrence, so one BoundedIsolatedValue's render() is called twice -- the memoized second call on BidiUtils$BoundedIsolatedValue.render line 209, which no corpus template reaches because no isolated template repeats a placeholder. maximumInterpolatedOutputCharacters is left at its default so the second render succeeds.
